capabilities: Load Geoapify vector map tiles and styles
Resolve POI search terms to places and coordinates
Read elevation along tracks and snap tracks to roads
disambiguation: Not a standalone places manager; it is a map provider that runs alongside the Places plugin.
extras: Not a standalone plugin; it must be installed alongside Places, and the README points to a sandbox for examples.
intentEvidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.
problem: The Places plugin needs a map and routing backend; this plugin adds Geoapify tiles, search, directions and related geo services.
